programme.desc: (2011) Family comedy. Jim Carrey stars as a work-obsessed New York property developer whose life is turned upside down when he receives a crate containing six live penguins.

programme.title: Deck the Halls

programme.desc: (1993) Romantic comedy with Tom Hanks and Meg Ryan. A bereaved man gets another chance at love when his son puts him on a radio talk show.

programme.title: Late Night with the Devil

programme.title: Adam Richman Eats Britain

programme.title: Adam Richman Eats Britain
programme.desc: Sandwich. Adam heads to Kent to try a very special sandwich in Sandwich. There, he also tries Whitstable oysters, traditional fish and chips, and a new baked sensation, the cruffin. S1, Ep2

programme.title: Adam Richman Eats Britain

programme.title: Adam Richman Eats Britain
programme.desc: Bakewell Pudding. In the Peak District, Adam learns more about the accidental invention of Bakewell pudding. Then, he visits a gastropub for his first taste of local grouse. S1, Ep4

programme.title: Adam Richman Eats Britain
programme.desc: Eton Mess. Adam samples the famous Eton Mess in Eton. He also enjoys afternoon tea fit for a Royal in Windsor, samples venison in bon-bon bar snacks and makes some tasty fudge. S1, Ep5

programme.title: Adam Richman Eats Britain
programme.desc: Glamorgan Sausage. In Wales, Adam tries Glamorgan sausage in Glamorgan. He enjoys Welsh rarebit and wonderful Welsh cakes, and bites into his Polish heritage with pierogis. S1, Ep6

programme.title: Adam Richman Eats Britain
programme.desc: Lancashire Hot Pot. Adam has a hearty hot pot in Lancashire. He also tries a Brazilian sausage roll, world-famous black pudding and kicking Korean chicken-topped waffle. S1, Ep7

programme.title: Adam Richman Eats Britain
programme.desc: Cheddar. Adam tries cheddar in Cheddar! He continues his rural discoveries with a cheesy celeriac bake with leeks that he harvests himself and farm-fresh chocolate milk. S1, Ep8

programme.title: Adam Richman Eats Britain
programme.desc: Melton Mowbray Pork Pie. Adam enjoys pork pie in Melton Mowbray before sampling boiled sweets, a chicken curry in Leicester and a mac and cheese doughnut from a village restaurant. S1, Ep9

programme.title: Adam Richman Eats Britain
programme.desc: Tattie Scone. Adam tries a tattie Scone in Scone, plus a full Scottish breakfast. He also tastes haggis, neeps and tatties, sausage casserole and sweet shortbread. S1, Ep10

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: From The Seas And Overseas. Guy Fieri reels perfect pierogies in Westminster, Colorado, killer Caribbean in San Antonio, Texas, and Southern seafood in Brunswick, Georgia. S39, Ep3

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: From Spicy To Sticky. Guy Fieri samples spicy and sweet foods, such as righteous rum cake in Georgia, artisan pizza in Colorado, and dynamite duck in San Antonio. S39, Ep4

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives

programme.title: Jamie Cooks Italy

programme.title: Jamie Cooks Italy

programme.desc: Jamie Oliver takes midweek meals up a notch, as he knocks out flavour-packed gnocchi, giant spicy meatballs, and an upside-down fish pie. S1, Ep4

programme.desc: Jamie Oliver whips up speedy smashed lemongrass chicken, flavour-packed sweet potato chilli with homemade nachos, and a chocolate party tray cake. S1, Ep5

programme.title: How Jaws Changed the World
programme.desc: Now 50 years old, Steven Spielberg's Jaws casts a long shadow on both the film industry and the fate of many shark species, leading to widespread slaughter around the world due to the fear it provoked in people. However, the movie also inspired a whole generation of marine biologists to specialise in sharks and this documentary reveals that much more is known now about this misunderstood species than ever before

programme.title: Love Your Garden
programme.desc: Alan Titchmarsh and his team of experts, Katie Rushworth, Frances Tophill and David Domoney, creates a modern family garden in Hucknall near Nottingham. The project is a surprise for a landscape gardener who was diagnosed with Alzheimer's at the age of just 32, making him one of the youngest people in the country to develop the condition and leaving him physically unable to complete the garden personally. Alan also provides viewers with some tips on sensory planting and creating home-made play equipment for children

programme.title: James Martin's Great British Adventure
programme.desc: The chef's countrywide tour brings him to Exmouth in Devon and a rendezvous with Michael Caines, the owner of Lympstone Manor, a country house hotel and restaurant with stunning views over the River Exe. He gets in the kitchen with Michael to see a Michelin-starred chef at work and then bakes his own lardy cake. James also visits a local vegetable farmer - and cannot resist the chance to drive his tractor - and gathers mussels with fisherman Myles Blood Smyth

programme.title: John and Lisa's Christmas Kitchen
programme.desc: John Torode and Lisa Faulkner have got Christmas covered with classic dishes to serve up for the festive season, starting with sausages three ways and a trio of tempting glazes. The menu also includes a turkey crown with spiced roast root vegetables for a true centrepiece, two family recipes that John and Lisa cannot wait to share, and John's ultimate festive trifle, where he goes all out for a truly sensational pudding to share with family and friends

programme.title: Ainsley's Festive Flavours
programme.desc: Ainsley Harriott throws open the kitchen doors and welcomes friends old and new for a Christmas feast. Actress and comedian Donna Preston pops in for a slice of mouth-watering tamarind, allspice and ginger glazed ham, with a juicy side of pineapple and rum relish, while actor Christopher Biggins joins for a taste of Ainsley's showstopping snow dome dessert, packed with festive flavours. Chef Phil Vickery lends a hand and offers up a party-friendly taste of the sea with his squid, prawn almond patties, and wine expert Jilly Goolden selects drinks for every occasion. Plus, music from classical star Alexis Ffrench

programme.title: James Martin's Great British Adventure

programme.title: John and Lisa's Christmas Kitchen

programme.title: The Odessa File
programme.desc: 1974. Thriller. Directed by Ronald Neame. Stars Jon Voight, Maximillian Schell & Maria Schell. A reporter tries to track down a number of SS officers who mysteriously vanished after the war.

programme.title: Champion
programme.desc: 1949. Drama. Directed by: Mark Robson. Stars: Kirk Douglas, Marilyn Maxwell & Arthur Kennedy. The struggles of a boxer fighting his own demons while trying to achieve success.

programme.title: SOS Pacific
programme.desc: 1959. Drama. Directed by Guy Green. Starring Richard Attenborough, Pier Angeli & John Gregson. A flying boat fire forces its passengers, including a prisoner, to make a disastrous water landing.

programme.title: The Big Combo
programme.desc: 1955. Crime. Director: Joseph H. Lewis. Stars Cornel Wilde & Jean Wallace. A police lieutenant, on a mission to bring down an elusive crime boss, targets the gangster's girlfriend to get her help.

programme.title: Law Of The Plainsman
programme.desc: 1960. Calculated Risk. Stars Michael Ansara, Don Grady & Gina Gillespie. While chasing after two bank robbers, Sam kills one in self-defence. The robber's son then threatens to kill Sam.

programme.title: The Great Rupert
programme.desc: 1950. Family Comedy. Directed by Irving Pichel. Stars Jimmy Durante, Terry Moore & Tom Drake. A little dancing squirrel with lots of charm helps two families overcome their obstacles.

programme.title: The Gentleman Bandit
programme.desc: 1981. Crime drama directed by Jonathan Kaplan. Based on the real-life ordeal of Baltimore priest Bernard Pagano who was arrested for a series of hold-ups.

programme.title: Tomorrow at Ten
programme.desc: 1962. Thriller. Director: Lance Comfort. Stars John Gregson, Robert Shaw & Alec Clunes. A race against time when police have to find a kidnapped boy with a bomb that will detonate at 10 o'clock.

programme.title: The Stories Behind the Songs
programme.desc: Join Kate Garner at the piano as she recounts the stories behind some of the great Victorian parlour songs and how the sunny 'Come Into The Garden Maud' started life as a dark and ominous poem.

programme.title: The Runaway Bus
programme.desc: 1954. Comedy. Director: Val Guest. Stars Frankie Howerd, Margaret Rutherford & Petula Clark. An inept bus driver gets lost in fog with a group of passengers, on a coach laden with stolen gold.

programme.title: Hobson's Choice
programme.desc: 1954. Drama. Director: David Lean. Stars Charles Laughton, John Mills & Brenda de Banzie. Henry Hobson's three daughters want to marry, but he refuses as traditions require him to pay settlements.

programme.title: Look At Life A Year for a Day
programme.desc: 1961. A look into the business of Christmas and the individuals who spend most of the year contributing to the festivities.

programme.title: John and Julie
programme.desc: 1955. Comedy. Director William Fairchild. Stars Colin Gibson, Lesley Dudley, Noelle Middleton, Sid James & Peter Sellers. Two children sneak to London so they can watch the Queen's coronation.

programme.title: Christmas In Britain - Glimpses
programme.desc: Join the festive cheer all over the country in this short film showing how Christmases past were celebrated in London, the great British countryside and a traditional British home.

programme.title: Cash on Demand
programme.desc: 1961. Drama. Directed by Quentin Lawrence. Stars Peter Cushing, Andre Morell & Richard Vernon. A crook abducts the wife and child of a bank manager and then schemes to rob the institution.

programme.title: Christmas 1946 (ABC)
programme.desc: 1946. Father Christmas offers an assortment of gifts and wishes everyone a bright Christmas and a Happy New Year in this jolly short film from the directors, management and staff of ABC Cinemas.

programme.title: Z-Cars
programme.desc: Suspended. 1962. Brian Blessed, Joseph Brady & Jeremy Kemp. Jock and Fancy are accused of theft when responding to a burglary and are suspended while the department investigates.

programme.title: Cellar Club with Caroline Munro
programme.desc: Caroline Munro opens the Cellar Club tonight with the fourth frightening episode of Omega Factor.

programme.title: The Omega Factor
programme.desc: After-Image. 1979. Stars James Hazeldine, Louise Jameson & John Carlisle. Drexil is using his powers to experiment on people using sensory deprivation. One of his targets is Anne.

programme.title: Cellar Club with Caroline Munro
programme.desc: Up next at the Cellar Club is the feature film of tonights show. Caroline Munro introduces the 1960s dramatic horror, Last Woman on Earth.

programme.title: Last Woman on Earth
programme.desc: 1960. Drama. Director: Roger Corman. Stars Betsy Jones-Moreland, Antony Carbone & Robert Towne. A couple go scuba diving while on vacation. They surface to find everyone on the island has died.

programme.title: Cellar Club with Caroline Munro
programme.desc: As Caroline Munro closes tonight show, she gives us an insight into next weeks very special show.

programme.title: Moon of the Wolf
programme.desc: 1972. Horror. Director: Daniel Petrie. Stars: David Janssen, Barbara Rush & Bradford Dillman. A werewolf may be stalking the Bayou, forcing Whitaker to confront superstition and deadly reality.

programme.title: That's Joey

programme.desc: Harold wants to go to Switzerland for Christmas whilst Albert - as usual - prefers Bognor; he is persuaded to go provided they sail rather than fly. S8 E7: A Perfect Christmas

programme.desc: When Travis goes missing in Morocco, Sharon, Tracey and Dorien move heaven and earth to track him down and bring him home for Christmas. 2016 Christmas Special: There's a Girl in My Souk

programme.title: Birds of a Feather Xmas 2017
programme.desc: Tracey has got big plans that could upset the festive harmony, Sharon has found a novel way of doing her Christmas shopping, and Dorien has got a mystery to solve. 2017: The House for the Rising Sons

programme.title: Birds of a Feather Xmas 2020

programme.title: Some Mothers Do 'Ave 'Em Xmas 74

programme.title: Some Mothers Do 'Ave 'Em Xmas 75
programme.desc: Classic sitcom starring Michael Crawford as the hapless Frank Spencer. As Christmas approaches, Frank takes just one more lesson before yet another driving test. Some Mothers Do 'Ave 'Em: S2 E8

programme.title: Mr. Bean
